ideas.idea: Drop the Disallow: /account line so the noindex can be seen by crawlers
ideas.why: The report's own reasoning is sound in general, but /account being noindex and disallowed is a stated deliberate choice, so recommending removal reverses it.

ideas.idea: Add address, postcode and directions as text on /visit, since the description promises directions
ideas.why: The description says 'Opening times and directions' but the page has only opening months and days, so the mismatch is real and fixable.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness structured data for hours and address on /visit
ideas.why: The user said having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, and this is a structured-data push.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD for site identity
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is declared as not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: Accurate, as the sitemap has no lastmod, but it has little effect on a three-page site.

ideas.idea: Give each variety its own page at /varieties/<name> and link to it
ideas.why: The varieties page names only two of over forty varieties and has no per-variety URLs, so individual pages would give crawlers and people something specific to find.

ideas.idea: Back up 'since 1952' and 'over forty' with a history section and a full variety list
ideas.why: These claims appear in the page text without support, and a full list adds real content for readers and machines to read.

ideas.idea: Add contextual body links from the home page to /varieties and /visit
ideas.why: The home page body has no links, but the nav already links to both pages, so the gain is small.
No page sets openGraph, so this is accurate, but it applies to almost any site and mostly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with app/sitemap.ts instead of hand-editing public/sitemap.xml
ideas.why: Accurate, but with three static pages the benefit is minimal.
